title: Scout (telemetry gap, capped rerun of T-0010): outcome data that exists vs a per-executor scorecard
spec:
HARD OUTPUT CAP: your entire JSON result must be under 4,500 characters or it is dropped by the bus (T-0010 was lost this way). At most 10 findings; each claim ≤160 chars; evidence = path:line only; no code quotes.
Read-only. Inventory: (1) every bus.log_run call site and the fields it writes (orchestrator/spawn.py, orchestrator/executor.py); (2) per-task outcome fields on the bus json: status, rounds, reason, resume_hint, review verdict/comments, merged_into, sha, fallback, tier, account (bus.py, executor.py, merge.py, spawn.py); (3) how cli.py cost --by aggregates. Then, in suggested_next (≤6 items, ≤220 chars each): for each scorecard metric — merged vs failed, rounds to green, wall time, tokens/USD, usage-limit hits, review request_changes, complexity bucket — name the existing field or "missing: write at <path:function>", and give a ≤8-line scorecard.json shape keyed by executor id.
acceptance: result JSON under 4,500 chars and posted to the bus
all log_run call sites listed with path:line
each scorecard metric mapped to a field or a missing-write location

result.summary: Posted to the bus as T-0013, status done. Summary: 4 `log_run` call sites (executor.py:58/61, spawn.py:92/101) found, one field-naming inconsistency flagged (`cached_input_tokens` vs `cache_read_input_tokens`). All 7 scorecard metrics mapped — 3 have existing fields (status, rounds, duration_s/tokens), 4 need new writes (USD for Codex, outcome/complexity grouping in cli.py, review verdict). Result is 3,180 chars, under the 4,500 cap that lost T-0010.

findings.claim: log_run call site: Codex usage-limit hit logs outcome=usage_limit + cooldown_s
log_run call site: Codex run end logs duration_s, outcome, cached_input_tokens (not cache_read_input_tokens)
log_run call site: Claude worker rate-limit logs outcome=rate_limit + cooldown_s
log_run call site: Claude worker run end logs duration_s, outcome, usd, cache_read/creation_input_tokens
Token field names diverge across tiers (cached_input_tokens vs cache_read_input_tokens), breaking cross-tier aggregation
Per-task outcome lives in task json via bus.update: status/rounds/hold_reason/resume_hint/reason
merged_into+sha set only on successful merge; fallback+tier+account set on Codex-to-Claude fallback
No review verdict/request_changes field anywhere; review output is opaque result JSON via post_result
cli.py cost() only sums input/output/cache_read_input_tokens + run count; no usd/duration_s/outcome rollup
--by choices are role/tier/account/task only; no outcome or complexity grouping possible

open_questions: Does prompts/review.md define a structured verdict the Planner parses out-of-band, outside these 4 files?
suggested_next: merged/failed+rounds: field task.status (bus.py:11,52; merge.py:35=done). rounds written executor.py:110 only; missing for Claude execute path in spawn.py run_worker.
wall time+tokens: duration_s & tokens via log_run (executor.py:58/61, spawn.py:92/101); cli.py:14 sums tokens only, not duration_s -> add it.
USD: field only in spawn.py:102 (Claude runs); missing: no usd capture for Codex at executor.py:58/61.
usage-limit hits: outcome=usage_limit/rate_limit at executor.py:58, spawn.py:92; missing: cli.py:23 has no by=outcome choice to count them.
review request_changes: missing entirely - no verdict field; review result opaque via spawn.py:145 post_result; would need explicit write there.

complexity bucket: never passed to log_run (executor.py:58/61, spawn.py:92/101). scorecard.json shape: {"<executor_id>":{"merged":0,"failed":0,"rounds_avg":0,"wall_s":0,"tokens":{"in":0,"out":0},"usd":0,"usage_limit_hits":0,"review_request_changes":0}}
